summary: Implemented the decathalon datalist loader. Files: monai/data/decathalon_dataloader.py (load_decathalon_datalist plus private _resolve_path helper; standard library only), an explicit export in monai/data/__init__.py, a "Decathalon DataLoader" autofunction subsection under Utilities in docs/source/data.rst, and tests/test_load_decathalon_datalist.py (class TestLoadDecathalonDatalist with four tests). Choices made where the spec was open: missing image or label fields are skipped rather than raising; a non-list value under the data_list_key raises ValueError; "test" entries are wrapped as {"image": entry} before validation. Verification: no tests or code were run, per instructions; I checked by awk that no changed file has a line over 120 columns. Nothing was committed.
